rules: Post maximum is 3,000 characters, including spaces and line breaks (official LinkedIn Help).
Keep the opening sentence self-contained and under roughly 210 characters as an editorial target; no verified fixed 210-character organic fold. Truncation varies by layout/device.
Use natural topic terms: LinkedIn content search and its March 2026 feed guidance describe semantic relevance, not a keyword-density trick.
Use zero to three relevant hashtags at the end as a restrained editorial choice, not a verified platform cap or reach guarantee.
Include the resource URL in the post for the requested conversion. No primary evidence reviewed supports a universal external-link penalty or guaranteed advantage to hiding links in comments.
Offer a specific professional takeaway, practical steps, one relevant discussion question and follow invitation. Avoid engagement bait and promises of employment.
Keep the AI-avatar disclosure; do not promise a LinkedIn comment-triggered DM because this funnel is Instagram-only.
Google autocomplete provides qualitative query phrasing, not LinkedIn search volume, rank potential, audience size or guaranteed demand.
Use the parent agent’s actual account analytics for scheduling; this keyword research does not establish a best posting hour.
limitations: No authenticated LinkedIn search-volume data used.
No post automation or external-link reach guarantee.
Do not convert Google LinkedIn search suggestions into a claim this workflow scrapes LinkedIn; it uses permitted employer career pages.
